followUpWebhook.notes: Phase 2 — when enabled, every event save POSTs the event payload (with pre-baked one-click action URLs in `actionLinks`) to this URL — typically a GoHighLevel inbound webhook that drops the data into an email template. The sharedSecret is sent in the X-CrockSpot-Signature header so GHL can verify the request, and is also used to HMAC-sign the action URLs so the team's email click-throughs are auth'd without anyone seeing a token. Default: DISABLED. Do not enable until Steven and Peter have opted in to receiving follow-up emails.
